messages:
maya: Heads up — Foghorn Systems (acct FOG-114) hasn’t paid INV-2026-0093 for 45 days. Invoice shows $78,432.19. They replied saying the spike was from a one-off data migration; asking to split payments. Need ops on options.

diego: cc @maya — I’ve been on calls with them. They acknowledged the balance and asked for a 3-month installment. ARR ~ $1.1M, healthy customer but cash-constrained this quarter. I recommend 30% up front.

olivia: they also flagged specific days with anomalous usage (2026-02-10 to 2026-02-12). I exported a quick usage snippet: token_hours: 12,400, 9,500, 11,600. They’re pushing for a small credit for the migration noise.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0093 status changed to "past_due" (45 days). Dunning stage: 2. Next scheduled retry: 2026-03-20. Last payment attempt: cc declined.

maya: Proposed options: (A) 3-mo plan 30/35/35 + block further overage until plan in place; (B) 50% now + 50% next month + 2% financing fee; (C) escalate to collections and suspend service. Need revenue/legal sign-off for B or C.

nina: prefer option B to preserve relationship, but want legal to confirm contract remediation. @sam can you confirm we can suspend non-essential features only?

sam: I can confirm contract SOW includes a "non-payment remediation" clause. We can pause non-essential features with 7 days' notice. Applying a 2% fee is allowed if agreed in writing; I recommend we offer no fee upfront and reserve it as fallback.

diego: customer verbally accepted a 3-month plan on the call and asked for a written plan. They also requested a $4,000 goodwill credit for the migration.

maya: Quick math: 30% upfront on $78,432.19 = $23,529.66. With $4k credit that's $19,529.66 due now. Cashflow-wise that's acceptable. We should require autopay + signed agreement for the credit.

olivia: I can get their signature once legal signs off on the wording. Also note: they asked us not to state we caused the spike — keep wording neutral.

sam: Agreed. Draft language: "dispute of usage patterns" and "mutual agreement to payment plan". Do not admit liability.

maya: OK I’ll draft the plan tonight. @nina please sign off on not applying the 2% fee unless they default.

nina: sign-off: offer a 3-month 30/35/35 plan with a $4,000 conditional credit if they sign and enable autopay. No financing fee at sign-up. If they miss an installment, escalate to collections and suspend non-critical features after a 7-day notice.

billing-bot: Payment plan created: PLAN-FOG-2026-03-A (3 installments). Next payment due: 2026-04-01.

maya: Thanks. Diego/Olivia — can you confirm acceptance from the customer by EOD? If no reply, I’ll send final notice and escalate.

diego: Pinged Mark (POC) just now.

olivia: Mark replied in email: "We can do 30% now, send the plan." Forwarding screenshot. :+1:

diego: Mark also asked if services will be suspended during the plan. I’ll reply per nina: non-critical features only, and only after default + 7-day notice.

maya: Sent the formal plan and payment link (Stripe partial invoice). Mark submitted the initial payment of $19,529.66 — shows as pending in portal.

billing-bot: Payment received: $19,529.66. Payment method: ACH. Remaining balance: $58,902.53. Plan status: active.

maya: Marking thread closed unless they miss the next installment. I’ll post an update if payment fails.

(threads like this are short — keeping record here for collections audit and CS handoff)
